categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Sepax Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: analytical chromatography and industrial purification. The company develops, manufactures, and sells chromatography columns and chromatography media used in drug analysis, detection, and purification processes, serving the entire drug development lifecycle from research to commercial production. It also provides related consumables, equipment, and technical services, focusing on biopharmaceutical applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies including microsphere synthesis, surface modification, and functionalization techniques for chromatography media. It has developed proprietary seed swelling polymerization methods for precise control of particle size and pore structure, surface nanocoating technologies to reduce nonspecific adsorption, and functional group grafting for diverse separation modes. Additionally, it innovated shell-core composite chromatography media technology, breaking international monopolies, and employs rigorous quality management systems across production sites.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sepax Technologies serves global biopharmaceutical companies engaged in antibody drugs, insulin/peptides/GLP-1, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid drugs, gene therapy, and small molecule drugs. Key customers include leading pharmaceutical and biotech firms such as Roche, Pfizer, Eli Lilly, Regeneron, Moderna, and major domestic companies like Innovent, Gan & Lee, and Qilu Pharmaceutical. The company supports clients from early-stage R&D through clinical trials to commercial manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production facilities in Suzhou and Yangzhou, and has subsidiaries in the United States responsible for R&D, production, and sales. It serves customers globally, including markets in the US, Europe, Australia, South Korea, Russia, and emerging markets such as India and South America. Its overseas subsidiaries and sales teams enhance its global market presence and customer service capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sepax Technologies operates mainly in the midstream segment of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, producing critical chromatography consumables such as columns and media used for drug analysis and purification. It provides key materials and technical solutions essential for downstream drug manufacturing and quality control, collaborating closely with pharmaceutical companies to support their production processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance chromatography materials, focusing on enhancing microsphere synthesis, surface modification, and functionalization technologies. It invests significantly in R&D to develop new products like high-load, alkali-resistant Protein A affinity media, advanced agarose microspheres, and shell-core composite media. Strategic R&D projects target emerging biopharmaceutical segments including ADCs, GLP-1, mRNA, and gene therapies, aiming to expand product pipelines and improve purification efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Sepax Technologies generates revenue primarily through the direct sales of chromatography columns, chromatography media (fillers), and related consumables. It employs a direct sales model complemented by distributors, especially for analytical chromatography products. The company also provides value-added technical services such as process development, custom product development, and purification solutions, which enhance customer retention and generate additional revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global industry leaders such as Thermo Fisher, Cytiva (Danaher), Merck KGaA, Tosoh, Agilent, and Waters. Sepax is recognized as a leading domestic player with growing international influence, particularly noted for its advanced technology platforms and successful import substitution in China. It holds a niche as one of the few companies globally capable of producing both analytical and industrial purification chromatography media at scale, positioning itself as a trusted partner for biopharmaceutical companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sepax Technologies achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 315.46 million, representing a 28.65% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 85.16 million, up 62.25%, with a net profit margin improvement driven by scale and operational efficiencies. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio (~13.59% of revenue) and has steadily expanded production capacity, including a large-scale facility in Yangzhou with plans for further expansion. Its market share in domestic analytical chromatography and industrial purification segments is growing steadily.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sepax Technologies emphasizes its comprehensive core technology platform enabling precise control over microsphere size, pore structure, and surface chemistry, resulting in high-performance chromatography media with superior stability, low nonspecific adsorption, and high load capacity. Its innovative shell-core composite media technology and customized purification solutions provide clients with efficient, cost-effective, and reliable products. The company’s strong quality management, extensive application expertise, and global customer service network differentiate it as a trusted partner supporting biopharmaceutical innovation and production.
